questions.q:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

24 ÷ 12 - 6 × 6 + 2 = 18
questions.solution:
Interchanging ÷ and ×

24 × 12 - 6 ÷ 6 + 2

= 24 × 12 - 1 + 2 = 288 - 3 = 285 ≠ 18

Interchanging + and ÷

24 + 12 - 6 × 6 ÷ 2

= 24 + 12 - 6 × 3 = 24 + 12 - 18 = 18 = 18

Interchanging + and -

24 ÷ 12 + 6 × 6 - 2

= 2 + 6 × 6 - 2 = 2 + 12 - 2 = 12 ≠ 18

Interchanging × and +

24 ÷ 12 - 6 + 6 × 2

= 2 - 6 + 6 × 2 = 2 - 6 + 12

= 8 ≠ 18

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.q: The sum of the current ages of Asma and her grandfather is 80 years. 10 years from now, Asma’s age will be one-fourth of her grandfather’s age. What is Asma’s current age?
questions.solution:
As per the question,

Let current age of Asma be X and that of her grandfather be Y.

Sum of their age = X + Y = 80 …(i)

Age 10 years from now,

X + 10 will be of Asma and Y + 10 of her grandfather, also given that

X + 10 = 1/4 (Y + 10) …(ii)

From (i) X = 80 - Y put in (ii)

80 - Y + 10 = 1/4 (Y + 10)

90 - Y = 1/4 (Y + 10)

360 - 4Y = Y + 10

5Y = 350

Y = 70

Put Y = 70 in (i)

Therefore, X = 10

Hence, 10 is the correct answer.

questions.q: Who presides over the joint sitting of the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Speaker of Lok Sabha.

Important PointsThe Speaker of Lok Sabha presides over the joint sitting of the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha.

• The Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha presides over in his absence. If he is also absent, then the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha presides over it.

• The Chairman never presides over the joint sessions.

Key Points

A joint sitting is summoned in the following* three situations, *(in which one House passed the Bill and transmitted it to the other House)

• If the other House rejects the bill.

• disagreements have arisen between the Houses regarding the amendments to be made in the Bill.

• If the other House withhold the Bill without being passing it for more than six months.

The President is the one who summons the joint siting.

• The provision for joint sitting is not applicable for *Money bills and Constitution amendment bills.*

questions.q: Before the 104th Constitutional amendment act 2020, under which article of the Constitution of India can members of the Anglo Indian community be nominated to the Lok Sabha by the President?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 331.

• In January 2020, the Anglo-Indian reserved seats in the Parliament and State Legislatures of India were abolished by the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019

• Om Birla is the 17th and current speaker of Lok Sabha.

Key Points

• Under article 331 of the Constitution of India can members of the Anglo Indian community be nominated to the Lok Sabha by the President.

• Article 342 covers The Scheduled Tribes in India.

• Article 330 deals with the reservation of seats of SCs and STs in Parliament.

• Article 326 was amended in 1988 by the 61st Amendment Act, 1988. It lowered the voting age from 21 years to 18 years.

Additional Information

• The Rajya Sabha should consist of not more than 250 members - 238 members representing the States and Union Territories, and 12 members nominated by the President. Each member is elected for a term of six years.

• Jagdeep Dhankar is the current Chairman of Rajya Sabha and the present Vice-President of India.

• 104th Constitutional Amendment Act ceased the reservation of seats for Anglo-Indians in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative assemblies and extended reservations for SCs and STs for up to ten years.

questions.q: Two articles are sold for Rs. 4880 each, on one article the seller gained 22% and on the other he lost 20%. What is his overall gain or loss percentage, nearest to one decimal place?
questions.solution:
Correct Answer 3.4% loss

SP of each article = Rs. 4,880

CP of first article = 4,880 × [100/122] = 4,000

CP of second article = 4,880 × [100/80] = 6,100

Total SP of both article = 4,880 × 2 = 9,760

Total CP of both article = 4,000 + 6,100 = 10100

Total loss = 10,100 - 9,760 = 340

Loss percentage = [340/10100] × 100 = 3.36% ≈ 3.4%

questions.q: Walking at 3/4 of his usual speed, a person reaches his office 18 minutes late than the usual time. His usual time in minutes is∶
questions.solution:
Concept Used:

As we know,

Time is inversely proportional to speed.

Calculation:

Let the usual speed of the person be 4x

And, Speed of the person after decreasing = 3x

Ratio of usual speed to after decreasing = 4x ∶ 3x

Ratio of usual time to after decreasing = 3x ∶ 4x

Now, 4x - 3x = 18

⇒ x = 18

3x = 18 × 3 = 54 min

questions.q: In a circle with centre O, an arc ABC subtends an angle of 132° at the center of the circle. Chord AB is produced to point P. Then ∠CBP is equal to∶
questions.solution:
As we know
